title: Growing Heart Emoji 💗 Meaning: Feelings Getting Bigger
description: The 💗 growing heart emoji is a pink heart ringed with outlines, as if expanding. It shows affection that swells: being touched, proud or falling harder.
summary: The 💗 growing heart emoji is a pink heart surrounded by larger outlines, as if swelling. It means affection that is increasing or overflowing: being touched by a gesture, growing closer to someone, or feeling your heart get full. It is used warmly between friends, family, and partners.
meaning: Picture the cartoon moment when a character's heart swells out of their chest. That is 💗. The layered outlines show a heart getting bigger, so the emoji fits feelings that expand in response to something: a thoughtful message, a baby photo, a friend showing up when it counted. It often answers a kindness, saying 'that made my heart full.'

In relationships it suggests development. Someone might use it when they notice they like a person more with every conversation, or when a long partnership still deepens. It is tender more than passionate. Because the outlines can also look like a pulse radiating outward, some people read it as a heartbeat and use it for nervous excitement, which is why one of its common shortcodes is 'heartpulse.'

Day to day, plenty of users treat 💗 as simply 'a nice pink heart' and send it interchangeably with other pink hearts. That casual use is fine and widely understood. It appears in supportive comments, pregnancy and newborn announcements, breast cancer awareness posts where pink is the campaign color, and messages of encouragement.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It is a natural reply to something sweet: 'you remembered 💗.' It also closes supportive messages to a friend having a hard time. The effect is gentle. Compared with a red heart it is less intense, and compared with 💕 it feels more sincere and less breezy.

contexts.label: From a partner or crush
contexts.body: From a partner it says their love keeps growing. From someone you are dating it can be an early, careful sign of deepening feelings, stronger than a smiley but short of a declaration. Watch for it after moments of closeness, such as a long call or a meaningful conversation.

contexts.label: On social media
contexts.body: People leave 💗 under family photos, wedding posts, and good-news announcements to show they are moved. It is frequent in parenting and wellness communities. Around October, it appears in breast cancer awareness content, usually with the pink ribbon, as a sign of support for patients and survivors.

examples.meaning: Touched by a small, thoughtful act.

examples.text: Every time we talk I like you a little more 💗
She said 'mama' for the first time today 💗
examples.meaning: A parent's heart swelling with love.

examples.text: Thinking of you this week, you've got this 💗
Thank you all for the birthday wishes 💗
examples.meaning: Heartfelt appreciation for many kind messages.

combos.meaning: Moved nearly to tears by something sweet.

confusedWith.difference: 💓 has short curved lines above it to show a heart thumping, and suits nerves and excitement. 💗 has full outlines around it and suggests growth. On small screens they look alike, and many people use either for both ideas.
💖 adds stars for a shiny, excited, decorative feel. 💗 is quieter and more emotional, about being moved or growing fonder.
🩷 is a plain pink heart with no effects, a newer addition used for soft, uncomplicated affection. 💗 adds the idea of feelings expanding.

avoid: Do not rely on it to make a serious romantic declaration, since many people read it as a casual pink heart.
Avoid it in formal or business messages, where any heart may be too familiar.
design: A pink heart framed by one or more larger heart-shaped outlines in lighter or contrasting pink, creating a ripple effect. Some vendors draw a solid heart with two concentric borders while others shade layers from dark to light. The design is meant to suggest motion, a heart expanding outward.

faqs.q: What does 💗 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: She feels warmly toward you or was touched by something. It is a common friendly heart, so it is not a sure sign of romance. In a dating context it can hint that her feelings are growing.

faqs.q: What does 💗 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: He is showing soft affection. Since guys use pink hearts less often on average, it may be a deliberate choice to seem gentle and sincere. From a boyfriend it means his love keeps growing.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 💗 and 💓?
faqs.a: 💗 is drawn as growing, with outlines around the heart. 💓 is drawn as beating, with vibration marks. In practice both express warm, lively affection, and the difference is one of nuance.
It can be, but it is equally at home between friends and family. It is best understood as a heart for tenderness and being moved, with romance depending on who sends it.
